text: This run looked at the token-factory page without a set buyer or goal. In the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15), A4-cta failed because the button does not do its job, while A1-audience, A2-value, and A3-proof were held. The writer tried three angles: Variant A used familiar API access, Variant B offered contract assurance, and Variant C provided one model catalogue key. Both Jev and Judge 2 called Variant A better, but held it for a person after Jev flagged a phrase. The judges disagreed on Variant B, leaving it held, and both judges rejected Variant C at Gate 2.
